pages.text: $(bold)Bendable, Not Breakable$()$(br2)Skilled players may bend the tier system but not break it. A shortcut to one next-tier item early is a feature; a shortcut past an entire tier is a bug.$(br2)$(bold)Break$() = Create mixing produces diamonds in Tier 1.$(br)$(bold)Bend$() = Create mixing produces steel from iron and coal at a worse ratio than Thermal.

$(bold)Abundance, Not Scarcity$()$(br2)There are no resource locks: crops, building mods, QoL features and travel are all available from day one. What is gated is $(italic)power$(): weapons, armor, magic systems and dimensions.$(br2)You should never feel blocked from having fun. You may feel blocked from the next tier of power, and that is on purpose.

$(bold)Death Is a Cost$()$(br2)Keep inventory is on, so you never lose items on death. Your equipped gear does lose durability, and at zero an item goes $(italic)inert$(): it stops working but stays in your inventory.$(br2)Dying in Tier 1 is cheap. Dying in the End with Tier 4 gear is costly, and the Soulbound enchantment is the best insurance.$(br2)Full details: $(l:icraft:systems/death_penalty)Death Penalty$(/l).

$(bold)Boss Fights Are the Pinnacle$()$(br2)The best weapons in the pack, the Simply Swords unique weapons, drop only from bosses. You cannot craft them or trade for them, and each is matched to the theme of the boss that drops it.$(br2)So combat is the only path to the best gear: tier skipping through crafting will never give you what a boss kill does.
